proposal.hypothesis: Assigning eight independent rows to the eight SIMD groups in each 256-thread group removes threadgroup barriers and shared-memory reduction while caching eight half4 values per lane, reducing synchronization latency for 256x1024 RMSNorm.
One threadgroup per row with one cached half4 per thread plus SIMD/shared reduction needs only one input pass and two barriers, minimizing latency for 256x1024.
